The launch marks a significant expansion for the company, moving from August 31 to September 3, and going beyond its signature smart prayer rings to introduce the Zikr Ring R1 and the premium, diamond-set Aura series. The integration of smart hardware, software services, and AI for Muslim life scenarios represents a deliberate effort to create a cohesive user experience across different product categories. This approach not only diversifies the company's hardware portfolio but also positions it as a more central technology provider for its user base. The debut at LEAP 2026 from August 31 to September 3 serves as a platform to showcase this expanded vision to a global audience of technology professionals and consumers.

## Expanding the Smart Jewelry Ecosystem

The introduction of the Zikr Ring R1 and the premium Aura series faith jewelry represents a natural evolution of iQIBLA's core product offering. The company has established a foothold in the niche market of Islamic faith tech, and the new rings aim to cater to both practical utility and premium aesthetics. The Aura series, featuring diamond settings, suggests a strategic move to capture a higher-end segment of the consumer market that values both religious observance and luxury design. By launching these products at a major technology exhibition in Saudi Arabia, iQIBLA is positioning itself within a key demographic center for its target audience. The Zikr Ring R1 and Aura series are designed to directly integrate faith into daily life, providing users with an elegant and functional piece of smart jewelry. This expansion reflects the brand's commitment to creating products that resonate with the cultural and religious values of its user base, while also appealing to a broader market interested in high-quality wearable technology. The integration of advanced sensors and connectivity features ensures that these rings are not just symbolic, but also highly practical for modern consumers. ## Venturing into Health and Family Technology

In a significant move into health and family technology, iQIBLA launched the iQIBLA Health line, which includes the Hajj Band. This smart wristband is specifically designed to monitor pilgrims' health and safety during Hajj and Umrah. The introduction of such a device addresses a practical need for health monitoring during physically demanding religious pilgrimages. Alongside the Hajj Band, the company also unveiled a blood pressure smartwatch tailored for Muslim users, further expanding its health-focused offerings. These developments indicate a broader strategy to integrate health tracking with faith-based routines. The Hajj Band's ability to track vital signs and provide real-time health data is a crucial innovation for the millions of pilgrims who travel to Mecca each year. By focusing on the unique needs of this demographic, iQIBLA is demonstrating a deep understanding of its market and a commitment to providing solutions that enhance the safety and well-being of its users. The blood pressure smartwatch complements this by offering continuous health monitoring, allowing users to keep track of their cardiovascular health while engaging in their daily religious practices. The introduction of the iQIBLA Health line, including the Hajj Band and a blood pressure smartwatch, represents a significant expansion of the company's product portfolio. The launch of the iQIBLA Health line at LEAP 2026 from August 31 to September 3 underscores the company's commitment to innovation in this sector.

## Introducing AI for Muslim Children

Additionally, the company unveiled the Qimi AI product line, which is aimed at younger demographics and Muslim children. This line features the QIMI Phone, billed by the company as the world's first smartphone designed specifically for Muslim children, and the QIMI Watch K2s. The introduction of these devices suggests an effort to build brand loyalty from an early age and provide technology solutions that align with family values and religious education. The Qimi AI line includes features that promote educational content, parental controls, and engaging activities tailored to the cultural context of its users. The QIMI Phone and QIMI Watch K2s are designed to provide a safe and enriching digital environment for children, ensuring that they can explore technology without compromising their values. The success of the Qimi AI line will depend on how effectively it balances these features with the expectations of modern consumers. The comprehensive ecosystem strategy unveiled at LEAP 2026 sets the stage for future innovations and growth. The Qimi AI product line for Muslim children, including the QIMI Phone and QIMI Watch K2s, represents a strategic investment in the future of the brand.
